text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo, member of the "Golden Generation" and daughter of a legendary racer, is an Umamusume who commands attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has an undying determination to win, but comes off quite arrogant when dealing with others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vain as she may be, I've chosen to join her in facing the Twinkle Series. Our journey in racing has begun.
